homepage.title: Discover events around you
homepage.subtitle: An interactive event map where businesses and organizers share the best from your surroundings.

aboutPage.title: Get to know us better
aboutPage.intro: Nora connects people with events around them. In one place, you can discover concerts, parties, sports events, cultural events and other interesting happenings nearby.

why.title: Why was this app created?
why.text: We want to make it easier for people to find out what is happening around them. There is no need to search across multiple places anymore. Everything important is simple, clear and in one place.

forWhom.title: Who is the app for?
forWhom.text: Mainly for people who want to discover new experiences, have fun, do sports, explore new places and meet new people. At the same time, it is also for businesses and organizers who want to make their events more visible and reach more people.

easy.title: Is the app difficult to use?
easy.text: Not at all. Nora is designed to be simple, clear and easy to use. We want you to quickly find what you're looking for without unnecessary extra clicks.

benefit.title: What is the biggest advantage?
benefit.text: Everything is in one place. Instead of searching for a long time, you can simply open the map and instantly see what is happening around you — by location, date or event type.

future.title: What do we want for the future?
future.text: We want to create a space where people can easily discover interesting events around them and organizers have a simple way to reach their audience. The goal is to make discovering events fast, natural and clear.
